verdict.rationale: Semgrep CLI runs headlessly with `semgrep ci`/`semgrep scan`, integrates into CI providers, pre-commit hooks, and supports SARIF export and JSON output for automation; a hands-on probe confirms local CLI execution with JSON output and exit-code gating without login. Missing for 10: independent CI-pipeline case study or third-party benchmark of large-scale automated CI runs beyond docs and a single local probe.
